rules.copy: rt copy requires a compiler-proved Copy value; it never implicitly clones move-only storage
rules.take: rt take consumes an owned source place, including otherwise Copy handles; projections without slot invalidation must reject
rules.borrow: rt borrow creates a scoped shared loan; moving or mutably borrowing its owner while live must reject
rules.mutableBorrow: rt mut borrow creates an exclusive scoped loan; aliases and suspension must be checked
rules.share: rt share requires separate compiler-derived Copy and Share proofs, including nested type arguments and allocation domain
rules.mutableShare: rt mut share may only expose an explicitly guarded synchronized handle where the backend proves it, never an unguarded mutable alias
rules.boundaries: No borrowed payloads may escape via independent task, actor message, return, generator or suspension without a verified scoped contract
